verification.removeMsg: The institution loses its Verified badge until it is checked again.
verification.markMsg: Only after checking the institution's legal name, registration number, board affiliation, UDISE code and GSTIN against documents. The institution sees a Verified badge; it is removed automatically if they change those details.

dashboard.billingRun: Billing run: {{checked}} checked · {{invoices}} invoices raised · {{statusChanges}} status changes.

dashboard.allGood: All accounts are in good standing.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.subtitle: Subscription invoices across every institution. Record payments from the institution's page.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: What each plan costs, its limits and the modules it switches on.
plans.features: Features shown on the pricing card

switch.isPublicHint: Shown on sign-up and plan pages

plans.inUseNote_one: {{count}} institution is on this plan. Module changes apply to it the next time its plan is applied (plan change or payment); limits apply immediately.
plans.inUseNote_other: {{count}} institutions are on this plan. Module changes apply to them the next time their plan is applied (plan change or payment); limits apply immediately.
plans.renewsIntoHint: This plan is retired: at their next renewal, its institutions move to the plan picked here.
plans.renewsIntoHintActive: Only used once this plan is switched off: its institutions then move to the plan picked here at their next renewal.

roleTemplates.title: Role templates
roleTemplates.subtitle: The recommended roles every institution can start from — Principal, Class Teacher, Accountant, Front Desk…
roleTemplates.note: Institutions copy a template when they create a role from it — edits here only affect roles created afterwards. Pages of modules an institution doesn't have are left out of its copy.

tenants.title: Institutions
tenants.subtitle: Every workspace on the platform, its plan and its billing status.
tenants.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number. Share it securely.
tenants.oneRoleNote: The workspace starts with exactly one role — Institution Admin (locked, full access) — held by this administrator. They design every other role themselves.

tenantDetail.raiseInvoiceHint: Off for complimentary upgrades or trials. Trials never get an invoice.
tenantDetail.changePlanNote: Modules switch to match the new plan immediately. Usage above the new plan's limits blocks the change.
tenantDetail.payNote: The institution becomes Active for the period this invoice covers.
tenantDetail.limitsIntro: Give this institution more (or less) than its plan — e.g. extra users as part of a deal. Leave empty to use the plan's limit.
tenantDetail.suspendMsg: Only its administrators can still sign in, and only to pay.
tenantDetail.cancelMsg: Nobody can sign in. Data is kept.
tenantDetail.internalNotesHint: Only the platform team sees these.
tenantDetail.voidMsg: Use when the invoice was raised by mistake.
tenantDetail.noInvoicesHint: Invoices appear when the institution subscribes or renews.
tenantDetail.paymentRecorded: Payment recorded — the institution is active.
tenantDetail.linkSent: Payment link emailed to {{email}} and copied.
tenantDetail.linkCreated: Payment link created and copied. The institution has no owner email to send it to.
tenantDetail.dealIntro: % off every invoice for this institution, after the plan price and before GST. A coupon at checkout comes off on top.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Who the platform is, how it sends email, and whether institutions can sign up on their own.

company.title: Company
company.subtitle: Shown on platform emails and, later, on subscription invoices.
company.name: Display name

email.title: Outgoing email
email.subtitle: The SMTP server the platform sends security notices, sign-in codes and invoices through.
email.passKept: Saved — leave empty to keep it
email.testHint: Email counts as working once a test goes through. Changing the server settings needs a new test.
email.saveFirst: Save your changes first, then send a test.
email.testSent: Test email sent to {{to}}. Outgoing email is working.
email.why: Until a test email goes through, the platform sends no email: password-change notices are skipped, and features that need email (sign-in codes, invites) stay off.

signup.title: Self sign-up
signup.label: Institutions can start a free trial on their own
signup.hint: Off: the sign-up page says so, and new institutions are added from Institutions.

payments.title: Online payments (Razorpay)
payments.subtitle: The platform's own Razorpay account. Institutions pay their subscription invoices into it; it is not any institution's gateway.
payments.webhookHint: In Razorpay › Webhooks, add the address below with this secret, for order.paid, payment.captured and payment_link.paid. It marks invoices paid even when the payer's browser never comes back.

notice.title: Notice banner
notice.subtitle: A message at the top of every screen and the sign-in page — planned maintenance, news.
notice.placeholder: Planned maintenance on Sunday 2–3 am: the app may be unavailable for a few minutes.
notice.untilHint: Empty: until you switch it off.

sms.title: Text messages (SMS)
sms.subtitle: Sends one-time codes — parent and student app sign-in — for institutions that haven’t connected their own SMS account. An institution’s own account always comes first.
sms.testNote: Test mode: nothing leaves the server and the code shows on the person’s screen. Not available in production.
sms.senderHint: Six letters, as approved on DLT
sms.templateId: DLT template id for the code
sms.textHint: Must match the DLT template word for word. {{code}}, {{institution}} and {{minutes}} are filled in. Empty: the standard text below.
sms.testHint: Sends a sample code with the saved settings. Institutions use platform SMS once a test has gone through.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.pageSubtitle: Codes an institution enters when it subscribes or changes plan, for % off that invoice.
coupons.subtitle: % off one invoice
coupons.emptyHint: Create one for a launch offer or a partner — institutions enter it at checkout.

staff.title: Platform staff
staff.subtitle: Who can use this console, and what each may change. Everyone can look; owners manage staff, settings and the audit log.
staff.emailHint: A separate email from any institution login.

roleHints.OWNER: Everything, including staff, platform settings and the audit log.
roleHints.BILLING: Payments, invoices, payment links, plan changes, deal discounts and coupons.
roleHints.SUPPORT: Add institutions; change their status, trial, limits and notes; role templates.
roleHints.READONLY: Can look at everything, change nothing.

staff.resetMsg: They get a new temporary password (shown once) and are signed out everywhere.
staff.tempIntro: Give this to {{email}} privately. It works for 72 hours, only to set their own password.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every change made in this console, and every console sign-in. Kept for two years.
